answer_1.quote: Task-oriented dialog systems help users complete pre-defined tasks ... we evaluate our algorithm on the MultiWoZ dataset ... end-to-end response generation ...

answer_2.quote: In MultiWoZ, response generation performance is evaluated by a combination of three metrics: Inform rate ... Success rate ... BLEU ... Finally, the Combined score is calculated as (Inform + Success) × 0.5 + BLEU.

answer_4.quote: We ask crowd‑workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to compare responses generated by baseline (MTTOD) and finetune+KRLS ... responses are rated in terms of their 1) appropriateness, 2) fluency, 3) informativeness, and 4) overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Crowd‑workers were shown two responses and asked to choose which one is better or if it is a tie for each of the four criteria: appropriateness, fluency, informativeness, overall quality.
